recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-38898 unless OO later changes DeviceRequest maturity in a separate decision.
issue_request: FHIR-38898 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to move DeviceRequest, listed under the older DeviceUseRequest artifact name, from FMM 0 to FMM 1 after its resource proposal had been approved.
initial_application: Commit e0157e2607913e36abf041d93616354a93f2785e set the active fhir.ini maturity entry to devicerequest=1 as part of OO FMM updates, and commit 113845b941e4a259175bd20710e78da8c485fb14, titled FHIR-38898, changed source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml from structuredefinition-fmm 0 to 1.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source keeps source/fhir.ini and the DeviceRequest StructureDefinition aligned at FMM 1. OO Confluence minutes for 2022-12-05 reference the FHIR-38898 Jira vote, and earlier OO/Zulip context records the resource-proposal rationale for getting DeviceRequest FMM updated from its DeviceUseRequest history.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already has structuredefinition-fmm value 1 and fhir.ini devicerequest=1.
